info.title: DualMind Arena API
info.description: The REST API behind DualMind Arena: blind battles, votes, the leaderboard, models and threads.

post.description: Send one prompt to two models in parallel and get both answers plus a `comparisonId` to vote with. Leave `model1`/`model2` empty for a blind Battle (`random` or `topper`), or set both for Side by Side.

example.prompt: Write a haiku about distributed systems

200.description: Both responses and the comparison ID.

example.message: Prompt is required and cannot be empty

post.description: Direct Chat: send a prompt to one model (or `auto` for a random one) and get the full reply.

Explain TCP vs UDP with a pizza analogy

post.description: Same request as `POST /api/arena/chat`, but the reply streams back as Server-Sent Events. Each event is a `data:` line with a JSON object: `ai.stream.delta` chunks, then one `ai.stream.done`. Errors arrive as an `ai.error` event.
Vote on a battle. Each signed-in user can vote once per comparison. Voting marks the comparison as revealed.

500.description: The vote could not be recorded, e.g. unknown comparison or you already voted.

get.description: Public. Returns every ranked model with its ELO score, rank and win/loss/tie counts, ordered by rank.
Every active model you can use, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of threads to return.

post.description: Create an empty thread. New threads are `private`.

mode.description: The Arena mode this thread is for.

get.description: Owners can always read their threads. `public` and `unlisted` threads can be read by anyone, without a token, while public sharing is enabled.

401.description: The thread is private and no valid token was sent.

403.description: The thread is private and belongs to someone else.

get.description: All turns in a thread, oldest first. Same access rules as `GET /api/threads/{threadId}`. With a token, `voteChoice` and `hasVoted` reflect your own votes.

401.description: The thread is private and no valid token was sent.

403.description: The thread is private and belongs to someone else.

patch.description: Change who can see a thread. Share links use `https://arena.dualmindlab.tech/share/{threadId}`.

403.description: Only the owner can change visibility.

get.description: Public. Check whether a feature is switched on, e.g. `public_sharing`.
Public liveness check. `/api/health` returns the same response.

bearerAuth.description: The access token from your DualMind Arena session (a Supabase JWT). See Authentication.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired token. The body is empty; the `WWW-Authenticate` header explains why.

prompt.description: The user prompt. Must not be empty.
prompt.example: Explain TCP vs UDP with a pizza analogy

model.description: Model to use: a `modelName` (or `modelId`) from `GET /api/models`, or `auto` to let the Arena pick a random model.

threadId.description: Save the prompt and reply to this thread. You must own the thread.

prompt.description: The prompt both models answer. Must not be empty.
prompt.example: Write a haiku about distributed systems

selectionMode.description: How the two models are picked when `model1` and `model2` are not set. `random`: two different random models. `topper`: the model with the best win rate against a random challenger.

model1.description: Left model (`modelName` or `modelId`). Set both `model1` and `model2` for a Side by Side comparison; setting only one is an error.

system.description: Optional system prompt sent to both models.

threadId.description: Save this battle to a thread you own.

message.description: The model's reply as plain text (Markdown).

output.description: The same reply in a structured content envelope.

responseTimeMs.description: Wall-clock time of the request in milliseconds. In a battle both models run in parallel, so this is the time until both finished.

arena.description: Simple length and token heuristics plus the model names. Clients that want a blind experience should keep model names hidden until the user votes, as the Arena does.

userWinner.description: Always `null` here; votes are submitted separately.

AiError.description: Error envelope used by the chat endpoints (and as an SSE event on the stream).

Error.description: Error envelope used by the threads, voting, models and settings endpoints.

voteChoice.description: `left` = `agent1` wins, `right` = `agent2` wins, `tie` = both good, `both-bad` = neither was helpful.

voteDurationMs.description: Optional: how long the user took to decide, in milliseconds.

LeaderboardEntry.description: One model on the leaderboard. snake_case aliases (`model_id`, `model_name`, `display_name`, `provider_name`, `elo`, `elo_rating`, `wins`, `matches`, `total_matches`, `win_rate`) are also returned for older clients.

eloScore.description: Current ELO rating. New models start at 1000.

eloRank.description: Rank by ELO (1 = best). Equal scores share a rank.

totalResponses.description: Number of comparisons the model has appeared in.

mode.description: `battle` = blind Battle, `arena` = Side by Side, `direct` = Direct Chat.

ThreadMessage.description: One turn in a thread. Single-model turns only fill the `model1*` fields.

comparisonId.description: Set for battle turns; use it to vote.

voteChoice.description: Your vote on this turn, if any.

instanceId.description: Identifier of the API instance that served the request.
